title: Turkish Kunefe Recipe
description: A traditional Turkish dessert made with crispy phyllo dough and melted cheese.
instructions: Thaw the phyllo dough according to the package instructions.
Cut the phyllo dough into 4 equal pieces.
Place one piece of phyllo dough on a flat surface and brush with melted butter.
Repeat the process with the remaining phyllo dough pieces.
Place the kunefe cheese on top of the phyllo dough, leaving a 1-inch border around the edges.
Fold the phyllo dough over the cheese to form a square shape.
Brush the top of the phyllo dough with melted butter.
Bake the kunefe for 20-25 minutes, or until the phyllo dough is golden brown and the cheese is melted.
Remove the kunefe from the oven and let it cool for 5 minutes.
Drizzle the honey over the kunefe and sprinkle with chopped pistachios.
